work.description: The act preaches at the consecration of St Paul's outside the Walls. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF22959-22959 reads: HABITA DIE X. DECEMBRIS MDCCCLIV. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita die X. Decembris MDCCCLIV, retained. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
